noah.b: Heads-up - I'm submitting an accommodation request. I've had recurring lumbar pain + diagnosed sleep apnea. Oncall night shifts and our standing desk setup are both triggering symptoms.

tara.hr: Thank you for sharing, Noah. We're here to help. Please submit the ADA intake when you can. In the meantime, we can trial interim measures. What would help immediately?

noah.b: Ideally: 1) remove him from back-to-back night oncall rotations for 60 days, 2) approved ergonomic chair and monitor arm, and 3) option to do remote triage during bad flare days (short-notice). I can provide a clinic note next week.

devon.eng: From an engineering perspective, we can swap Noah out of the night rotation and shift coverage. Question: how do we handle incident ownership during his remote triage days? We need clear runbook handoffs.

tara.hr: Good point. Interim plan should include: explicit handoff procedure, who owns paging, and maximum acceptable response times while triaging remotely. HR can draft the temporary accommodation with those details.

oncall-bot: Deploy notice: oncall-rotation v2 applied. Pager schedule updated.

amelia.p: I volunteer to pick up two of Noah's night rotations for the next 30 days. Also happy to act as primary escalation for live incidents when he's in remote triage.

devon.eng: Thanks, Amelia. Noah, could you outline what "remote triage" means for you (e.g., respond to page within X minutes, or just ack + delegate)? That way we can set realistic expectations in the plan.

noah.b: I can aim to acknowledge pages within 15 minutes and attempt initial triage for priority P1s. For prolonged hands-on debugging that requires >30 min, I need a warm handoff to the onsite responder. If I feel pain flare worsening, I may DM the oncall lead to hand off immediately.

tara.hr: That sounds reasonable as an interim accommodation. I'll create an interim plan document: list accommodations, duration (60 days), success criteria (no missed P1s due to delayed ack, ergonomics delivered within 14 days), and 14/60-day check-ins.

devon.eng: We'll add a short runbook section for warm handoffs and update the oncall playbook with the 15-min ack expectation for triage-mode responders.

tara.hr: HR note: Case HR-8123 opened: "ergonomics + modified oncall (Noah B)". Intake recorded 1815011200. Assigned to tara.hr.

noah.b: Thanks everyone. I'll upload the clinic note when it's available. Appreciate the quick coverage offers and the chair/monitor approval.

amelia.p: No worries. Ping me if you want to do a dry run of the handoff.

tara.hr: Draft plan will be posted here by EOD for signatures. Confidentiality reminder: only share details with people on the case. :lock:
